summary: XPENG INC. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 26, 2026, reporting the poll results of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on the same date. The filing includes the adoption of its Tenth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association via special resolution. No terms such as stake %, price/share, or premium are present as this is a routine governance update, not a special situation event. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of meeting outcomes. There are no deal mechanics, break fees, or risk-arb angles to assess.
